purpose: Teach: 元年/時空/界隈/特質/総称/現存/波長/即興

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、令和元年からの医療制度変化を医療チームで追います
lines.en: Ren — we track changes in the healthcare system since Reiwa-1 as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Direct eye contact level. The tone of someone laying out work before them without drama.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、時空を超えて伝わる伝統医療を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Yes — traditional medicine knowledge, passed down across generations, we learn together as a team.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slightly slower, pedagogical. A small pause before the explanation, as if letting the importance settle.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病院界隈の救急体制を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Ren — we're strengthening the emergency response system in the hospital network as a medical team.
lines.style: Calm, direct. Same measured baseline as the first line. Professional responsibility without heaviness. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 遺伝性疾患の特質を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: We do research on the characteristics of genetic disorders here at your hospital, don't we, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, slightly deferential. Genuine curiosity underneath — this is a real question testing what he's picked up. Quiet respect for her expertise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療機関の総称ガイドラインを医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes — we reference the comprehensive clinical guidelines as a medical team framework.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Brief, efficient. The tone of someone confirming a protocol. Slight warmth underneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現存する古文書医学書を、貴院、保管されてますね、先生
lines.en: You preserve historical medical texts here at the hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, slightly wondering. He's noticing something — there's warmth in his curiosity. Hesitant because he's asking permission to acknowledge what she does.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、脳波の波長解析を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes — we conduct EEG wave analysis as a medical team.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Steady pace. Matter-of-fact. The briefest line, delivered without embellishment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、救急現場では即興判断を医療チームで日々求められます
lines.en: Yes — in emergency situations, the team is called on daily to make split-second decisions.
lines.style: Calm, grounded. Small weight on the reality of 'daily' and 'split-second.' No strain in the voice — she's stating fact. Close, conversational — almost to herself.
